title: I burned all my tokens researching how to save tokens
summary: A developer shares their experience building a custom deep research pipeline that optimizes LLM token usage and API costs while maintaining research quality. The article explores various strategies for reducing computational expenses in AI-powered research workflows.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of excessive API costs when running large-scale AI research queries using deep research pipelines.
why_valuable: Provides practical optimization techniques that can significantly reduce LLM operating costs while maintaining research effectiveness, which is crucial for production AI applications.
